### Kansallisarkisto

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://kansallisarkisto.fi/)

The National Archives of Finland describes Astia as the service for searching archival datasets, viewing digital materials and arranging access to analogue materials. Its parish and population-list guides help research the Grand Duchy and cross-border families. Finnish and Swedish locality and parish names can differ from Russian forms; check the specific fonds and access terms.

Links: [https://astia.narc.fi/](https://astia.narc.fi/)

Holdings: Institutional guides identify parish archives and population/tax lists (henkikirjat).

Source: [https://kansallisarkisto.fi/en/archive-services/explore-materials/databases-and-registers/astia-en](https://kansallisarkisto.fi/en/archive-services/explore-materials/databases-and-registers/astia-en) · 2026-11-02 · institutional-service-guide-read
